005package org.wpilib.command3;
006
007import java.util.List;
008import java.util.function.Consumer;
009import org.wpilib.annotation.NoDiscard;
010import org.wpilib.units.measure.Time;
011
012/**
013 * Generic interface to represent mechanisms on a robot. Commands can require sole ownership of a
014 * mechanism; when a command that requires a mechanism is running, no other commands may use it at
015 * the same time.
016 *
017 * <p>Even though this interface is named "Mechanism", it may be used to represent other physical
018 * hardware on a robot that should be controlled with commands - for example, an LED strip or a
019 * vision processor that can switch between different pipelines could be represented as mechanisms.
020 */
021public interface Mechanism {
022  /**
023   * Returns the scheduler under which this subsystem and its default commands are registered. The
024   * scheduler is also used to fetch running commands for the subsystem.
025   *
026   * @return The registered scheduler.
027   */
028  default Scheduler getRegisteredScheduler() {
029    return Scheduler.getDefault();
030  }
031
032  /**
033   * Gets the name of this mechanism. This will default to the name of this mechanism's class.
034   *
035   * @return The name of the mechanism.
036   */
037  @NoDiscard
038  default String getName() {
039    return getClass().getSimpleName();
040  }
041
042  /**
043   * Sets the default command to run on the mechanism when no other command is scheduled. The
044   * default command's priority is effectively the minimum allowable priority for any command
045   * requiring a mechanism. For this reason, it's recommended that a default command have a priority
046   * less than {@link Command#DEFAULT_PRIORITY} so it doesn't prevent low-priority commands from
047   * running.
048   *
049   * <p>The default command is initially an idle command that only owns the mechanism without doing
050   * anything. This command has the lowest possible priority to allow any other command to run.
051   *
052   * @param defaultCommand the new default command
053   */
054  default void setDefaultCommand(Command defaultCommand) {
055    getRegisteredScheduler().setDefaultCommand(this, defaultCommand);
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Gets the default command that was set by the latest call to {@link
060   * #setDefaultCommand(Command)}.
061   *
062   * @return The currently configured default command
063   */
064  default Command getDefaultCommand() {
065    return getRegisteredScheduler().getDefaultCommandFor(this);
066  }
067
068  /**
069   * Starts building a command that requires this mechanism.
070   *
071   * @param commandBody The main function body of the command.
072   * @return The command builder, for further configuration.
073   */
074  default NeedsNameBuilderStage run(Consumer<Coroutine> commandBody) {
075    return new StagedCommandBuilder().requiring(this).executing(commandBody);
076  }
077
078  /**
079   * Starts building a command that requires this mechanism. The given function will be called
080   * repeatedly in an infinite loop. Useful for building commands that don't need state or multiple
081   * stages of logic.
082   *
083   * @param loopBody The body of the infinite loop.
084   * @return The command builder, for further configuration.
085   */
086  default NeedsNameBuilderStage runRepeatedly(Runnable loopBody) {
087    return run(
088        coroutine -> {
089          while (true) {
090            loopBody.run();
091            coroutine.yield();
092          }
093        });
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Returns a command that idles this mechanism until another command claims it. The idle command
098   * has {@link Command#LOWEST_PRIORITY the lowest priority} and can be interrupted by any other
099   * command.
100   *
101   * <p>The {@link #getDefaultCommand() default command} for every mechanism is an idle command
102   * unless a different default command has been configured.
103   *
104   * @return A new idle command.
105   */
106  default Command idle() {
107    return run(Coroutine::park).withPriority(Command.LOWEST_PRIORITY).named(getName() + "[IDLE]");
108  }
109
110  /**
111   * Returns a command that idles this mechanism for the given duration of time.
112   *
113   * @param duration How long the mechanism should idle for.
114   * @return A new idle command.
115   */
116  default Command idleFor(Time duration) {
117    return idle().withTimeout(duration);
118  }
119
120  /**
121   * Gets all running commands that require this mechanism. Commands are returned in the order in
122   * which they were scheduled. The returned list is read-only. Every command in the list will have
123   * been scheduled by the previous entry in the list or by intermediate commands that do not
124   * require the mechanism.
125   *
126   * @return The currently running commands that require the mechanism.
127   */
128  @NoDiscard
129  default List<Command> getRunningCommands() {
130    return getRegisteredScheduler().getRunningCommandsFor(this);
131  }
132}
